strategy.summary: Reproduce the convergence defect in sklearn ElasticNet coordinate descent at alpha=0 / l1_ratio=0 (PR #32845, buggy commit 4be3e7dd5826) by running the developer's updated test_enet_ols_consistency on the buggy revision (expected to fail: ConvergenceWarning 'Objective did not converge' with large duality gap, and se_enet <= se_ols <= 1e-20 assertion failing near 7e-26) and on the fixed revision (expected to pass with the alternative dual gap formulation A). Dependency versions are unconstrained by documentation; the reporter's versions (numpy 1.24.1, scipy 1.10.0, Cython 3.1.2, joblib 1.3.0, threadpoolctl 3.2.0, pandas 1.5.0, matplotlib 3.6.1, Python 3.11.14) are era-inferred from the issue's Versions block, not documented, so they are a choice to be made and stated rather than a requirement.

system_packages: libopenblas (OpenBLAS 0.3.25 pthreads, Haswell) or the OpenBLAS bundled with the numpy wheel
build_commands: pip install -r build_tools/requirements.txt or pip install numpy==1.24.1 scipy==1.10.0 Cython==3.1.2 joblib threadpoolctl pytest
pinned_because: numpy 1.24.1 and scipy 1.10.0 pinned from issue#32987 Versions block only (era-inferred, not documented); chosen to reproduce the reporter's BLAS/LAPACK stack
Cython 3.1.2 pinned because the extension must be rebuilt from the .pyx for the buggy and fixed revisions
Python 3.11.14 taken from the reporter's environment

strategy.success_criterion: On the buggy revision 4be3e7dd5826 the test fails: ElasticNet(alpha=0, tol=1e-15) emits ConvergenceWarning 'Objective did not converge' (duality gap ~7.3e+05 vs tolerance ~2.9e+02) and/or the assertion se_enet <= se_ols <= 1e-20 fails (e.g. 7.30e-26 <= 6.72e-26) for precompute=False; with -W error the warning itself turns into a failure. On the fixed revision (the PR #32845 patch applied with the test diff) the test passes: no ConvergenceWarning, se_enet <= se_ols <= 1e-20 holds, and assert_allclose on coef_ (atol=1e-11) and intercept_ (atol=1e-12) passes for all parametrizations [precompute x effective_rank].
strategy.numerical_probe: Fit ElasticNet(alpha=0, precompute=False, tol=1e-15) on make_regression(n_samples=300, n_features=100, effective_rank=10, n_informative=50, random_state=RandomState(42)) with sample_weight=RandomState(42)-continued uniform(0.01,10), and print the duality gap and n_iter_ on each revision.

input_output_examples.input: ElasticNet l1_ratio=0 (alpha=0) fit with coordinate descent on main branch
input_output_examples.buggy_output: Warning: Objective did not converge... Duality gap: 7.274e+05, tolerance: 2.886e+02
input_output_examples.expected_output: Solver converged without warnings; Dual gap achieved: 0.000000; Iterations used: 6

risks: The defect is numerical and seed/BLAS dependent; the reporter used OpenBLAS 0.3.25 Haswell with pthreads. On a different CPU architecture (e.g. ARM or a different OpenBLAS kernel) or a different threading layer the transition may not appear, so the buggy revision may pass and the test would not transition.

Assertions compare values near 1e-20 to 1e-26, i.e. floating-point noise level; the outcome depends on global_random_seed and on the exact sample_weight draw, which is only partially specified (sample_weight drawn from the same RandomState after make_regression is assumed).
The global seed is not stated for the failing cases beyond [42-10-False] and [59-None-True]; the [59-None-True] case may require SKLEARN_TESTS_GLOBAL_RANDOM_SEED=59 to reproduce.
Initial coefficients and the iteration at which the buggy path diverges are not stated in the evidence, so the exact warning text and duality-gap magnitude may differ.

The alternative dual gap (formulation A, referencing #22836) is only partially described; the fixed-revision pass depends on the PR patch being applied exactly as in the diff, which is taken as given.

The test file also changes test_enet_ridge_consistency, test_check_input_false and test_uniform_targets, and removes ConvergenceWarning ignores; the selected test_command only runs test_enet_ols_consistency so unrelated changes do not affect the transition, but a full-file run with -W error may fail for reasons unrelated to this bug.
No sanitiser or debug build is assumed; if the behaviour only shows under a sanitiser or a specific compiler, that is not reproduced by this plan.

oracle.tolerance: atol=1e-11 on coef_, atol=1e-12 on intercept_, se_enet <= se_ols <= 1e-20 absolute
oracle.reference_source: LinearRegression OLS fit on the same X, y, sample_weight within the test
oracle.why: The test asserts absolute tolerances near floating-point noise, so the oracle is tolerance-based with explicitly stated absolute thresholds.

strategy.fails_on_buggy: On 4be3e7dd5826 ElasticNet(alpha=0, tol=1e-15) does not converge: coordinate descent stops on a dual gap that is invalid at alpha=0, so ConvergenceWarning is emitted and the coefficients are not accurate enough; the assertion se_enet <= se_ols <= 1e-20 then sees se_enet larger than se_ols (7.30e-26 > 6.72e-26 on [42-10-False]) and fails. Under -W error the warning also fails the test.
strategy.passes_on_fixed: On the fixed revision the alternative dual gap formulation A gives a valid stopping criterion at alpha=0, the solver converges in a few iterations with no warning, and both the squared-error ordering and the absolute coef_/intercept_ tolerances hold, so the test passes.
